steps.entry: Pallet arrives in test position (ZS-2008 / X23 rising edge) while auto mode active (SS-0003 / X2), no ST20 fault (M299), and station idle (not M200)
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 made) and clamp open clear (ZS-2002B / X21 clear)
steps.name: CLAMP (M201)

steps.entry: Clamp closed confirmation satisfied from CLAMP step
steps.exit: PT-2001 reaches fill threshold (D100 >= D122 / 14.50 kPa) or aborts on fault/timeout
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Test window timer elapsed (T23) or abort condition triggered by active fault (M299)
steps.exit: Vent timer elapsed (T200), pack pressure vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 healthy (not M292)
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 made) and clamp closed clear (ZS-2002A / X20 clear)
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)

steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (ZS-2008 / X23 lost)
steps.name: DONE (M207)
